from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name from the filing")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets value")
    total_equity: float | None = Field(description="Total shareholders' equity value")
    cash_and_equivalents: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents value")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income value")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Value unit scale: dollars, thousands, millions")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
